more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Sodium lauryl sulphate is a mixture of sodium alkyl sulphates consisting chiefly of the lauryl compound. It is a surface-active ingredient used for emulsifying, whipping or wetting in particular food processes. FDA describes uses involving egg whites, marshmallow gelatine, certain fumaric-acid-containing drinks and fat fractionation. The amount and processing requirements are specific to each application.
more_info.uses: FDA lists emulsifying use with egg whites, whipping-agent use in marshmallow gelatine, surfactant use in certain fumaric-acid-containing drinks and wetting during fat fractionation. Application-specific concentration limits and subsequent refining requirements apply.
